author: Dushyant Chetiwal
name: Water-Filled Left-FWHT Column-Grouped E8-GPTQ + 4-Bucket rANS (with Hourglass k=2 NCM Ablation)
blurb: Drop-in Hessian-aware 8D E8 lattice quantization and 4-bucket scale-conditioned 32-bit C-rANS entropy coding on the PR #2135 11L/512d CaseOps stack. Beats PR #2135's scalar int6 GPTQ + lrzip head-to-head on identical 600s Seed-42 8xH100 weights (1.056343 vs 1.056799 post-TTT val_bpb; -0.000456 bpb / -0.00100 nats) at 616 B smaller total size (15,947,106 B vs 15,947,722 B), plus a controlled Hourglass k=2 Next-Concept Modeling (+44.3% token throughput, 1.090011 val_bpb) ablation.
